title: opencode-forge forge.json
description: Static worker subagent definitions for the opencode-forge plugin. The file is JSONC (comments and trailing commas allowed). Validation in the plugin is field-level fail-soft: a bad entry is skipped with a finding while its siblings still apply; this schema is an editor-side convenience mirror of that surface, not the enforcement. The plugin only ever READS this file.

$schema.description: Editor-side schema reference. Ignored by the plugin (unknown keys are tolerated).

pool.description: Namespace for this pool's materialized ids (forge-<ns>-<id>). REQUIRED for crew-governed dispatch: without a valid declared `pool`, `crew_begin` refuses registration and crew `forge-*` dispatches stay blocked until the field is added. Invalid values degrade to a warning + the directory-derived namespace. Ignored on the global fallback file (that namespace is fixed to "global"). Note: the plugin trims before validating, so a padded value passes the plugin but fails this schema — write it unpadded.

shared.description: Optional pool-level shared prompt segment, written once at the top of the file and inherited by every agent this file materializes. A plain string, no interpolation.

materialize.description: Roster materialization mode (GLOBAL layer file only). v2 hosts DEFAULT to "native" (the recipe compiles into .opencode/agent/forge-<ns>-<id>.md via forge_sync); "runtime" is the escape hatch back to draft materialization. v1 hosts stay runtime-pinned regardless. Any other value is ignored with a warning.

sync.description: Roster sync posture. Absent (default): the staleness gate refuses stale crews and the forge agent runs forge_sync in-band. "auto": a stale roster for this pool silently regenerates at session start with a disclosed finding. Any other value is ignored with a warning.

agents.description: Agent id -> definition. An ABSENT shape defaults to WRITE (open permissions). Unknown keys inside an entry are tolerated and ignored.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase [a-z0-9-]. A `forge-` prefix is tolerated (auto-stripped with a warning at load); write ids without it.

agent.description: One worker. model + thoughtLevel form an ATOMIC PAIR: set BOTH to pin the brain and depth, set NEITHER for an Auto worker (inherits the parent session's model at dispatch, provider-default depth). Exactly one of the two is rejected at load — the entry is skipped, its siblings still apply.

model.description: Exact "provider/model" string (as resolved by your opencode model config). Open string — no enum by design.

thoughtLevel.description: One thought-level word, written LOWERCASE. The dictionary ships none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max, but it is open — any word passes through verbatim on word-shaped channels. The plugin normalizes to lowercase with a warning if you write mixed case.

prompt.description: Short role description. An explicit prompt fully overrides the built-in defaults (only research/review ids have built-ins; any other id without a prompt gets a generic one-liner).

shape.description: Absent = WRITE (open permissions). "readonly" is the explicit seal: denies write/edit/bash + the patch family (patch/applypatch/apply/multiedit) and seals readonly workers' forge_shell to read-classified commands.

permission.description: Optional per-tool override map (tool name -> string verdict), e.g. { "bash": "deny" }. "task" is ALWAYS denied regardless of this map.

depths.description: DEPRECATED — ignored with a warning finding. Static agents pin ONE thoughtLevel; set "thoughtLevel" instead.
